annotations.title: Translate text, translation API: translate text into another language, about 100 languages

description: Translate text into another language with OpenAI's open-weight gpt-oss-20b, detecting the source language. Long text is split at sentence ends and checked, so a cut-off translation is an uncharged 502, never a success. Give the target as an ISO code such as en, sv, de, fr, es, zh or ja; less common languages use Meta's M2M100. Use to localise messages and documents. Example: text=Payment received, thank you!, to=sv. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
